messages:
sarah_csm: Urgent heads-up — Acme Finance has a SIG/CAIQ bespoke questionnaire due tomorrow EOD UTC. They need KMS/HSM attestation and audit-log export evidence. CS tried to pull the export but the
attachment endpoint returns 401. Can we triage? They asked for a 48h extension but legal needs a technical note.

jen_support: Thanks Sarah. Ticket created: CS-98421. Can you paste the exact error and repro so eng can reproduce?

sarah_csm: Pasting customer transcript and our repro below. Customer says: "Download fails with 401 when requesting /v1/admin/exports/:id/download — we can see the job succeed in console but download link returns 401 for service account user." They provided a curl they ran.

oliver_eng: Can you drop the curl + response body? Also which account (user vs service-account) and whether this is via Console or API.

sarah_csm: Repro steps from customer:
1) Create bespoke export via Console -> Compliance -> Exports (type: SIG-bespoke, includes KMS attestations + audit logs)
2) Wait for job to complete (status: succeeded)
3) Click download -> 401 returned

Customer curl: ```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  "https://api.redwood.prod/v1/admin/exports/exp_01ABC/download"

HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"unauthorized","message":"token_missing_scopes"}
```

ash_sre: Quick triage — 401 with token_missing_scopes usually means the token used for the download path is being exchanged and losing the admin:exports scope. We're seeing SSO token swap drop for tokens >20MB export metadata (size heuristic). Will check logs for exchange sidecar.

devon_security: Important: confirm whether the export includes HSM attestation PDFs (these are sensitive). If it's in the bundle we need strict access checks and audit trail. Don't advise customer to re-run export until we confirm redaction/consent.

oliver_eng: I can reproduce locally using a service-account token issued by the Console session. Repro steps match. I captured request IDs: request_id=rid-9c3a and backend_id=be-44ff. Trace shows 403->401 rewrite when our entitlement-check middleware times out on the token introspection when payload size >20MB.

ash_sre: Logs snippet (sanitized):
```
time=2026-02-12T14:02:03Z level=warn svc=auth exchange=svc-token-swap err="introspect timeout" req_id=rid-9c3a
time=2026-02-12T14:02:03Z level=info svc=exports service_export_id=exp_01ABC status=succeeded user=acct-xxxx
time=2026-02-12T14:02:04Z level=error svc=proxy upstream=auth status=401 msg="token missing scopes after swap"
```

oliver_eng: Root cause appears to be our token swap microservice dropping scopes when introspection of the claims hits the size timeout path. I have a small patch that increases the introspection timeout and falls back to direct-lookup for export scopes — PR #rwdw/exports/428. Will push a hotfix if CI looks clean.

devon_security: If hotfix is needed, we should get a mitigated release with feature-flag off by default and a manual QA checklist (verify exports for small+large bundles, verify HSM PDF access controls). Also capture an audit entry for every download attempt.

jen_support: For immediate workarounds for the customer: 1) Use Console -> Admin -> Export details -> Copy signed-download URL (Console issues a signed link that bypasses token-swap path) OR 2) Ask them to generate an export scoped to audit logs only (smaller) and download that while we fix. Is either safe from compliance POV @devon_security?

devon_security: Option 1 is acceptable if we ensure the signed URL is single-use and short TTL. For option 2, advise customer that HSM attestations won't be included so that might not satisfy their SIG question. Document the tradeoff in CS reply.

oliver_eng: CI looks green on the patch. I'm preparing a hotfix deploy to prod in the next 30m with the introspection timeout bump + direct-lookup fallback behind a feature flag rwd.introspect_fallback=true. Will monitor.

deploybot: deploy job rwdw/exports/hotfix-428 queued by oliver_eng — staging -> canary -> prod (manual promote). Job id: deploy-77821.

ash_sre: I'll watch canary. If we see no 401 spikes in 15m we can promote. Also adding short-term metric alert on exports.download.unauthorized count.

sarah_csm: Thank you all. I'll tell Acme we opened CS-98421 and requested a 48h extension while we apply a hotfix and verify. I'll include the Console signed-link workaround and note HSM caveat. Will update once customer confirms extension.

devon_security: Add to the SIG response pack: explanation of root cause, mitigation steps, timeline, and a copy of the audit entry schema we'll produce. I'll draft the language once we confirm hotfix success.

jen_support: Noted. Assigning owner: oliver_eng for the hotfix + ash_sre for monitoring. Sarah, I'll follow up with the extension note template you can send to Acme.

sarah_csm: Perfect — closing loop here. Follow-ups: oliver update deploy status in this thread, ash post canary metrics, devon attach final wording for SIG packet.

(END)
